title: Novel App knock-in mouse model shows key features of amyloid pathology and reveals profound metabolic dysregulation of microglia

evidence_spans.quote: Methods We engineered a novel App knock-in mouse model

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: Original mouse-model study in biological health; age-related observations are framed as Alzheimer’s pathology/model characterization, not an aging-process analysis.

causal_design_reviewer.exposure_or_intervention: Engineered App SAA knock-in mutations in mice
causal_design_reviewer.outcome: Amyloid pathology, microglial lipid/metabolite and transcriptomic responses, and brain metabolism
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: Outcomes in heterozygous and homozygous App SAA mice compared with wild type littermate controls

evidence_spans.quote: We engineered a novel App knock-in mouse model ... using homologous recombination to introduce three disease-causing coding mutations
heterozygous and homozygous App SAA mice
profound alteration of diverse lipids and metabolites as well as an exacerbated disease-associated transcriptomic response in microglia
Wild type littermate mice were used as experimental controls

causal_design_reviewer.concise_rationale: The completed report applies an engineered genetic perturbation and compares phenotypic and multi-omics outcomes with wild-type controls.
